# See your cash low point before it surprises you.

> Forecast when invoices and recurring bills could create a cash shortfall for your small business, including one-off payments like a quarterly tax bill or an insurance renewal, and see which payment to move.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
